notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible: two separately manipulated upper-cabinet doors and two separately manipulated drawers. The two cabinet-door closures occur close together between frames 304 and 328, so their individual off-transition ordering and midpoints are less certain than the drawer transitions.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens both individual doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator, then opens the top drawers on the left and right sides of the stove. The cabinet doors and both drawers are later closed.
